profile.summary: This portfolio was designed and built using Figma Make, Codex, and Claude Code. Powered by a custom prompt system that progresses through roadmap phases, executing build and QA tasks in an iterative loop.

operatorProfile.title: Stephen Howe
operatorProfile.description: This section gives an overview of the system operator and his personal quirks.
operatorProfile.notesBody: My work often sits at the meeting point of design and implementation. My focus is not the artefacts, but the systems that generate them - interface logic, motion templates, and production pipelines that scale while output remains consistent.

files.title: Operator Summary
files.body: Systems-focused designer working across product architecture, media pipelines, and technical prototyping. Builds repeatable frameworks for UI, motion, and AI-assisted production.

files.title: Working Style
files.body: Structured system design with iterative prototyping. Problems are reduced to inputs, constraints, and outputs, then rebuilt into reusable templates, rather than one-off solutions.

files.title: Current Focus
files.body: Video generation systems, AI-assisted development pipelines, interface architecture, and tools that reduce the distance between ideations and deployed products.

caseStudies.title: Recent Case Studies
caseStudies.description: Each case exposes the system behind the output: inputs, constraints, pipelines, and repeatable structures.

projects.title: UNCX Video & 3D System
projects.shortDescription: End-to-end video production pipeline spanning Cinema 4D, After Effects, and Redshift — built for repeatable, high-frequency output.
projects.fullDescription: A modular production system covering 3D scene assembly in Cinema 4D, Redshift rendering, After Effects compositing, and templated timeline structures. Designed so that product launches, explainers, YouTube tutorials, and partner content could all ship from the same asset library without rebuilding from scratch each time.

overlaySections.title: Brief
overlaySections.body: UNCX needed a repeatable video system that could support product launches, explainer series, YouTube tutorials, and partner content — without rebuilding from scratch for every deliverable.

overlaySections.title: Problem Frame
overlaySections.body: Production was fragmented across freelancers and one-off files. No shared asset library, no consistent motion language, and no templated pipeline — every video started from zero.

overlaySections.title: System Design
overlaySections.body: Built a modular pipeline: reusable 3D scenes and camera rigs in Cinema 4D, Redshift lighting presets, templated After Effects compositions with interchangeable content layers, and structured timeline blocks for consistent pacing across formats.

overlaySections.title: Prototype Notes
overlaySections.body: Isolated repeatable patterns in camera movement, lighting setups, and transitions. Abstracted these into reusable templates so new videos could be assembled rather than authored from scratch.

overlaySections.title: Delivery
overlaySections.body: Delivered as a production system: Cinema 4D scene templates, After Effects project structures, Redshift material libraries, YouTube thumbnail templates, and a defined motion language document.

overlaySections.title: Outcome
overlaySections.body: Cut production time significantly across campaigns. Enabled consistent, brand-aligned output regardless of content type — from 60-second launch trailers to multi-part tutorial series.

projects.title: Badger Club App
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack badge tracking platform with dark/light themes, role-based dashboards, Supabase backend, and Resend email integration.
projects.fullDescription: A multi-role product system managing badge progress tracking, leader administration, parent communication, and public-facing group pages. Built with React, Supabase, Resend email integration, and Cloudflare security. Supports dark and light themes with a structured database schema designed for scalable group management.

overlaySections.title: Brief
overlaySections.body: Build a badge tracking system that reduces admin overhead for group leaders while giving parents and children clear visibility into progress and achievements.

overlaySections.title: Problem Frame
overlaySections.body: Badge tracking was manual — spreadsheets, paper records, and inconsistent communication between leaders and parents. Leaders carried the full admin burden with no structured tooling.

overlaySections.title: System Design
overlaySections.body: Separated the system into operational layers: leader management dashboards for badge administration, parent-facing views for monitoring progress, child-friendly progress visualisation, and public group pages with Cloudflare security.

overlaySections.title: Prototype Notes
overlaySections.body: Focused on reducing cognitive load per role. Dark and light themes tested for readability. Database schema designed in Supabase with row-level security for multi-tenant group isolation.

overlaySections.title: Delivery
overlaySections.body: Full-stack implementation: React frontend with role-based routing, Supabase backend with structured schema, Resend for transactional emails, and Cloudflare for security and performance.

overlaySections.title: Outcome
overlaySections.body: Eliminated manual tracking overhead. Created a scalable product foundation with subscription-based monetisation and clear paths for feature expansion.

projects.title: UNCX Company Rebrand
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive rebrand spanning identity, marketing visuals, and a full website redesign across 10+ product pages in Figma.
projects.fullDescription: Rebuilt the UNCX brand from the ground up as a system of rules and components rather than a static identity. Covered typography, colour logic, layout rules, chain-specific visual treatments, and a complete website redesign in Figma spanning Homepage, Launchpad, Token Vesting, Staking, Minting, and more.

overlaySections.title: Brief
overlaySections.body: Create a scalable brand identity that could unify product UI, marketing materials, motion graphics, and a full website redesign across UNCX's multi-chain DeFi ecosystem.

overlaySections.title: Problem Frame
overlaySections.body: The existing brand was inconsistent — different visual treatments per product, no systemised colour or typography logic, and marketing outputs that didn't align with the product UI.

overlaySections.title: System Design
overlaySections.body: Defined typography scales, colour logic with chain-specific treatments, layout grid rules, component patterns, and motion alignment. Designed a full website in Figma covering Homepage, Launchpad, Token Vesting, Staking & Farming, Token Minter, Blog, and Team pages.

overlaySections.title: Prototype Notes
overlaySections.body: Tested brand coherence across UI mockups, motion graphics exports, marketing materials, and social media templates. Iterated on chain-based colour variations to maintain identity across Ethereum, BSC, and other networks.

overlaySections.title: Delivery
overlaySections.body: Delivered brand guidelines, Figma component libraries, website page designs, marketing visual templates, and motion style references.

overlaySections.title: Outcome
overlaySections.body: Achieved consistent visual output across all platforms and products. The brand system supported ongoing content production without design drift.

projects.title: Noticia Lingo App
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered language learning app using real news articles, Google authentication, Supabase backend, and structured quiz flows.
projects.fullDescription: A language learning platform that transforms live news content into structured learning experiences. Built with React, Supabase, and Google OAuth — featuring article-based lessons, interactive quizzes, a learner dashboard, and a settings system. Designed to replace static flashcard approaches with contextual, real-world content.

overlaySections.title: Brief
overlaySections.body: Build a language learning system that uses real-world news content instead of static lessons — making vocabulary acquisition contextual and engaging.

overlaySections.title: Problem Frame
overlaySections.body: Traditional language apps rely on decontextualised flashcards and repetitive drills. Learners lose motivation because the content feels disconnected from real usage.

overlaySections.title: System Design
overlaySections.body: Content pipeline: ingest news articles, extract vocabulary, generate contextual quizzes, and structure progressive difficulty. User system: Google OAuth, learner profiles, progress tracking, and configurable settings.

overlaySections.title: Prototype Notes
overlaySections.body: Tested readability scaling across article difficulty levels. Built interactive quiz flows with immediate feedback. Designed the dashboard to surface progress metrics without overwhelming new users.

overlaySections.title: Delivery
overlaySections.body: Working prototype with React frontend, Supabase backend, Google authentication, structured article reading flow, quiz system, and learner dashboard.

overlaySections.title: Outcome
overlaySections.body: Demonstrated a scalable learning system driven by live content. Active development with plans for AI-powered difficulty calibration and expanded language support.

projects.title: UNCX Academy Brand & Platform
projects.shortDescription: Educational platform brand and design system — logotype, component library, article system, video pages, and glossary for DeFi learning.
projects.fullDescription: End-to-end brand and platform design for UNCX Academy: custom logotype, component library, article categorisation system, video learning pages, glossary, integrations hub, and about page. Designed in Figma as a complete design system with reusable components and consistent visual language.

overlaySections.title: Brief
overlaySections.body: Design a complete educational platform brand and UI for UNCX Academy — covering identity, page designs, content structure, and a reusable component system.

overlaySections.title: Problem Frame
overlaySections.body: DeFi education content was scattered across blog posts, YouTube videos, and documentation with no unified platform, no consistent visual language, and no structured learning progression.

overlaySections.title: System Design
overlaySections.body: Created a custom logotype and brand identity. Designed a modular Figma component library. Structured content into articles, videos, glossary entries, and integrations — each with its own page template and navigation pattern.

overlaySections.title: Prototype Notes
overlaySections.body: Tested content hierarchy across article categories, video pages, and glossary. Ensured the component library supported both internal content authoring and public-facing learning experiences.

overlaySections.title: Delivery
overlaySections.body: Complete Figma design system: logotype, component library, page templates for Main, Articles, Videos, Glossary, Integrations, and About. Supporting brand guidelines for consistent content production.

overlaySections.title: Outcome
overlaySections.body: Enabled UNCX to launch a structured education platform aligned with the parent brand. The component system reduced design time for new content pages.

projects.title: UNCX Unified Menu
projects.shortDescription: Cross-product navigation component system with variable-driven Figma prototypes, research-backed hierarchy, and scalable state logic.
projects.fullDescription: A unified menu system designed to work across UNCX's entire product suite. Built as a variable-driven Figma component with researched navigation patterns, prototype states (open/closed), configurable content slots, and a scalable hierarchy that adapts to different product contexts.

overlaySections.title: Brief
overlaySections.body: Design a unified navigation component that could work across all UNCX products — replacing inconsistent per-product menus with a single scalable system.

overlaySections.title: Problem Frame
overlaySections.body: Each UNCX product had its own navigation pattern. Users moving between Launchpad, Token Vesting, and Minting encountered different menu structures, creating cognitive overhead and inconsistent UX.

overlaySections.title: System Design
overlaySections.body: Researched navigation patterns and hierarchy models. Designed a component-based menu with configurable content slots, variable-driven Figma states, and a scalable hierarchy that adapts per product context.

overlaySections.title: Prototype Notes
overlaySections.body: Built variable-driven Figma prototypes for open and closed states. Tested content slot flexibility across different product navigation requirements. Validated the component against mobile and desktop breakpoints.

overlaySections.title: Delivery
overlaySections.body: Delivered a Figma design system component with documented states, variables, content slot patterns, and implementation specifications for the development team.

overlaySections.title: Outcome
overlaySections.body: Replaced fragmented navigation with a single, consistent system. Reduced design and development time for new product navigation and improved cross-product UX coherence.

projects.title: UNCX App Prototyping
projects.shortDescription: Rapid prototyping across token minting, launchpad flows, Telegram bots, NFT minting, and ILO V7 — from wireframes to interactive concepts.
projects.fullDescription: A body of product concepting work spanning multiple UNCX features: token minter prototyping, launchpad UI components, Telegram chatbot and presale app flows, NFT minting interfaces, stealth launch concepts, and ILO V7 flow diagrams. Each concept was developed from wireframes through to interactive prototypes in Figma.

overlaySections.title: Brief
overlaySections.body: Rapidly prototype and validate product concepts across UNCX's feature pipeline — covering token minting, launchpad flows, Telegram integrations, and NFT tooling.

overlaySections.title: Problem Frame
overlaySections.body: New product features were being scoped without visual validation. Developers were building from text specs, leading to misalignment between design intent and implementation.

overlaySections.title: System Design
overlaySections.body: Created a concepting workflow: wireframe → component mockup → interactive prototype → stakeholder review. Applied this across token minter flows, launchpad components, Telegram bot interactions, and ILO V7 user journeys.

overlaySections.title: Prototype Notes
overlaySections.body: Token minter concepts explored multi-step creation flows. Telegram prototypes covered chatbot interactions, presale app flows, and ape-bot UIs. ILO V7 flow diagrams mapped the full initial liquidity offering user journey. Stealth launch concepts explored admin and user-facing interfaces.

overlaySections.title: Delivery
overlaySections.body: Delivered Figma prototypes for each feature area: token minting (blueprint and standard), launchpad components, Telegram bot/app flows, NFT minting interfaces, stealth launch admin, and ILO V7 flow diagrams.

overlaySections.title: Outcome
overlaySections.body: Closed the gap between product specs and development handoff. Stakeholders could validate features visually before committing development resources, reducing rework and accelerating shipping.
